newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FORINT FIRMS VS DOLLAR, BCE YEN FUTURES MOST TRADED.
newsitem.headline: FORINT FIRMS VS DOLLAR, BCE YEN FUTURES MOST TRADED.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed firmer against the dollar on Wednesday in what dealers said was an average day on the interbank forex market.
"After a routine morning, the afternoon was fairly slim," said Miklos Rabl of Creditanstalt.
The forint closed at 154.72 against the dollar compared with its opening of 154.95/155.00. Most of its gains came before midday on the back of a strengthening mark, Rabl said.
Dealers said the forint traded right on the central bank's resistance level throughout the day.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange, yen futures accounted for 962 million forints of a total 2.64 billion forints.
Swiss franc futures were the main movers, with two termins dropping and one rising. Ecu and lira futures also ended mixed, while the yen, dollar and marik remained mostly steady.
Budapest Interbank Offered Rate (BUBOR) futures opened for March 1998 and saw 10 contracts at 19.80 percent.
